author: 9to5Google
description:
Android 17 QPR1 Beta 3 is here with a fresh wave of UI refinements, including new frosted glass blur effects, bouncier animations, updated media controls, lock screen tweaks, and screen recording improvements. While this isn’t the full Android 17 release, it gives us an early look at the direction Google is heading ahead of the Pixel 11 launch and future Android updates later this year
